text: to all generations: Heb. to generation and generation
approve their sayings: Heb. delight in their mouth
beauty: Or, strength | in the grave, from their dwelling: Or, the grave being an habitation to every one of them
from the power: Heb. from the hand of the grave | grave: Or, hell
whiles he lived: Heb. in his life
he shall go: Heb. the soul shall go
